original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳议员律师批评EOCO持续拘留当事人，称“权力操弄令人作呕”
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳曼希亚南区议员Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah的律师Samuel Atta Akyea批评经济与有组织犯罪办公室（EOCO）对其当事人的持续拘留，称此举是“令人作呕的权力操弄”。该事件目前为单一来源报道，相关指控尚未获得独立证实。

key_facts.fact: 议员Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah的律师Samuel Atta Akyea批评EOCO对其当事人的持续拘留
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Lawyer for Manhyia South MP Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah, Samuel Atta Akyea, has criticised the continued detention of his client by the Economic and Organised Crime Office (EOCO).

key_facts.fact: Atta Akyea称该权力操弄“令人作呕”
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: ‘The power play is disgusting’ – Atta Akyea questions Baffour Awuah’s detention by EOCO

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（MyJoyOnline）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
